title: Video From Workspace
text: 从 MATLAB 工作区导入视频；输出 4 路；按 {Signal} 指定要读取的视频；{Sample time} 输出视频的采样周期、{Form output after final value by} 指定最终视频帧之后的模块输出形式 Setting、{Image signal} 指定视频信号的输出模式 One multidimensional、{Output port labels} 输出端口名称 R，按实例取值。

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 输出图像或视频 M -by- N -by- T array | M -by- N -by- C -by- T array

ports.name: R
ports.summary: 输入视频的红色分量 3-D array

ports.name: G
ports.summary: 输入视频的绿色分量 3-D array

ports.name: B
ports.summary: 输入视频的蓝色分量 3-D array

params.name: Signal
params.values: 要读取的视频 rand(32,32,3,5) (default) | M -by- N -by- T array | M -by- N -by- C -by- T array | MATLAB workspace variable

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 输出视频的采样周期 1 (default) | -1 | positive scalar

params.name: Form output after final value by
params.values: 最终视频帧之后的模块输出形式 Setting to zero (default) | Holding final value | Cyclic repetition

params.name: Image signal
params.values: 视频信号的输出模式 One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals

params.name: Output port labels
params.values: 输出端口名称 R|G|B (default) | text labels separated by vertical bars
